title: Paul F. McGuire Lecturer in Comparative Politics
affiliation: Paul F. McGuire Lecturer in Comparative Politics
bio: Pippa Norris, the Paul F. McGuire Lecturer in Comparative Politics at HKS, and Faculty Affiliate in the Department of Government, has taught at Harvard for three decades. She compares democracy, public opinion, elections, political communications, & gender politics worldwide.
